speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong
text: asked the Minister for Transport (a) what steps have been taken to ensure that the construction of Changi Airport Terminal 5 is in line with sustainability goals; and (b) whether steps are taken to future proof the development of the terminal against climate change.

speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr S Iswaran)
text: Changi Airport Group's 2022 Annual Sustainability Report addresses the second question.
